site.domainNote: self-hosted web UI for a multi-platform video/audio downloader (yt-dlp style) — download queue and history

view.name: Downloads home
view.description: Main download list with platform filter chips, cookies tip banner, active queue with progress bars and download history.

regions.label: Narrow navigation rail: VidBee logo, Home (active, amber tint), Subscribe, Tools; Preferences and About icons pinned to bottom
Pill filter chips by platform with counts (All, YouTube 78, Bilibili 11 …) and amber 'Add URL' primary button
Grey callout: 'Boost download success with cookies' with amber action button (untranslated key)

Download rows: thumbnail, platform icon, title, status line (percent + speed, Pending, Error, Cancelled, or timestamp), thin progress bar, hover actions (copy path, pause/resume, cancel, retry, download); error rows show red message and 'Report this error' links

evidence.note: Persistent icon+label rail with fixed destinations and settings/about at the bottom
Single-select platform chips with item counts; clicking Vimeo 7 live-filtered the list to 7 Vimeo items
Informational callout at top of content with one action button (label is an untranslated i18n key)
evidence.quote: Configure cookies to raise success rates from 70% to 99%.

evidence.note: Active download: percent + speed text with spinner, thin amber linear bar, pause and cancel buttons
Hovering a thumbnail reveals a checkbox (live); selecting shows a floating '1 selected' pill with delete at bottom-right. Not visible in static capture.

patterns.rationale: Only observed live: Add URL opens an anchored panel with a URL textarea, One-Click Download toggle, Cancel/Fetch; not in the capture.

evidence.note: Trigger for anchored 'Enter Video URL' panel (live)

patterns.rationale: The list is a reverse-chronological history of the user's own downloads with timestamps, but it is a download manager queue rather than an event log of changes; unclear fit.

evidence.note: Completed downloads listed newest first with date-time stamps
Clicking a row only selects it; no detail view opens
Rows are unbounded list items, not contained cards

structure.layout: app shell with narrow left icon rail (logo, Home/Subscribe/Tools, settings/about at bottom) and a single-column main panel: platform filter chip bar + Add URL button, a cookies tip banner, then a long vertical list of download rows (thumbnail, platform icon, title, status/progress, row actions)

aesthetics.typography: Open Sans throughout: 14px titles, 12px meta/status/chips, 10px uppercase tracked eyebrow in the banner, 12px rail labels
aesthetics.typeScale: Very flat: 14px/400 titles vs 12px/400-500 meta; only hierarchy via weight in bold percentages and the uppercase 10-11px eyebrow; no large headings

notes: Bee-themed downloader (VidBee) with amber/honey accent: amber pill Add URL button, amber progress fill on pale cream track, amber-tinted active rail item and selected row. Platform identity carried by small colored brand glyphs (YouTube red, Bilibili blue, SoundCloud orange, Twitch purple, TikTok/X black) both in filter chips and before each title. Row actions are icon-only circular buttons (copy server path, pause/resume, cancel, retry) right-aligned; error rows show red monospace-ish error text and small outline 'View logs / FAQ / GitHub / Email feedback' report buttons. A visible untranslated i18n key 'history.cookiesTipAction' appears on the banner button. Hidden behaviors (live): hover checkbox on thumbnails enables multi-select with floating '1 selected' + delete pill; Add URL opens an anchored panel with textarea and One-Click Download toggle. Main panel scrolls internally.
